column1: # Trials behind speed.md. Written by `mise run bench:speed:only`; do not edit by hand.
# Machine: 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-12900KF, 16 threads, win32 10.0.26200
# Scope: Scoped to 5 rows by the patterns leaderboard, largerecord, taggedunion, nested, with every column, timing encode and decode, in 2 runs back to back.

# Method: 9 trials per cell, each at least 0.2 seconds of calls after 0.1 seconds of warm-up calls, timed in chunks of 250 calls so that the yields between chunks are not in the time; within a row the libraries take turns, one trial each, and 3 idle frames separate one row from the next; before any trial, every cell decodes its buffer once, and a run in which a cell round-trips worse than the size table records is not recorded
